name: Loom -> SOP Generator (Global)
problem: Operations teams re-record the same walkthroughs because no one converts them into documented SOPs.
solution: Paste a Loom link -> FIRE transcribes, segments steps, and produces a Notion-ready SOP with screenshots placeholders.
distribution: Product Hunt, LinkedIn ops content, Notion template marketplaces
mvp: Paste-link form -> transcription -> structured SOP; manual QA before automation.
validation_experiment: Land 10 beta teams from a LinkedIn launch post; success = 5 convert to paid.

name: WhatsApp Voice-Note -> Quote for Tradespeople
problem: Tradespeople (plumbers, electricians) lose jobs because writing formal quotes takes hours; customers ghost on verbal estimates.
customer: SA tradespeople who use WhatsApp Business for jobs
solution: Forward a voice note -> FIRE transcribes -> produces branded PDF quote with itemised pricing in minutes.
distribution: WhatsApp Business API + local trade WhatsApp groups + referrals from hardware stores
mvp: Manual concierge MVP: human transcribes VN, fills quote template, replies within 5 min; then automate with API.
validation_experiment: Sell to 10 plumbers in one week via DMs; measure: % who send a 2nd voice note (retention), % who pay.
kill_criteria: <5 of 10 first-touch prospects send a quote request
optimize_criteria: 5-7/10 send voice notes but 0-1 pay -> tighten offer/price ladder, 7-day trial
turnaround 5-30 min -> rebuild template, pre-fill common line items + rates
high response, <50% of responders send voice notes -> rewrite first-touch script
prospects want to pay but payment is friction -> add EFT details / PayFast link

name: Content Repurposing Pipeline
problem: Founders record one podcast/long video and have no time to clip it into 10 platform-native posts.
customer: SA founders & creators (and global via USD)
solution: Drop a long video -> FIRE outputs 10 clips, captions, hooks, and a 30-day posting calendar.
distribution: LinkedIn/TikTok content marketing; affiliate with podcasters
mvp: Concierge: human clips top 5 moments using AI transcript timestamps.
validation_experiment: 10 creators trial; success = 5 publish the calendar and renew.
kill_criteria: clip quality below their edit bar

name: No-Show Reminder for Small Medical Practices
problem: Private GPs and dental practices lose revenue to no-shows; reminder staff time is expensive.
solution: FIRE sends appointment reminders + collects confirmations via WhatsApp/SMS, with waitlist fill.
distribution: Medical suppliers, practice manager associations, direct demos
mvp: CSV import -> automated reminder flow; success metric = no-show % delta.
validation_experiment: 2 practices for 6 weeks; measure no-show rate before/after.

name: CAPS-Aligned Study Material Generator
problem: SA learners can't afford tutors; parents want curriculum-aligned summaries for exams.
solution: Pick subject + topic -> FIRE generates CAPS-aligned notes, practice questions and memos.
pricing: R49 per pack; R149/mo all subjects
distribution: Schools (paid licensing), parent WhatsApp groups, exam-season SEO
mvp: Quality gate: human subject-matter review of the first 50 packs before any automated release.
validation_experiment: Exam-season pilot (Oct); 100 packs; parent reviews on accuracy.
kill_criteria: content errors in any reviewed pack

name: Google Maps Review Engine for Local SA Business
problem: Local businesses (restaurants, salons, garages) rank low because they have 4 reviews; competitors have 50.
customer: Local SA SMBs already advertising on Google Maps
solution: FIRE automates the ask: post-visit WhatsApp/SMS link that makes leaving a review a 10-second tap, and responds to every review.
distribution: Google Business Profile agencies, local SEO workshops
mvp: Manual: teach owner to send review link; automate follow-up reminders.
validation_experiment: 10 businesses; measure review-count growth in 30 days vs baseline.
kill_criteria: owners won't share customer contact lists

name: WhatsApp Booking Agent for Salons & Spas
problem: SA salons lose bookings after hours; no-shows cost them ~20-30% of slots; manual DMs are slow.
solution: Client DMs 'book me Sat 10am' -> FIRE checks availability, confirms, sends reminder + deposit link.
distribution: Salon industry WhatsApp groups, distributor partnerships
mvp: Shared calendar + manual confirmation first; reminder automation day 1.
validation_experiment: 3 salons pilot for a month; measure no-show rate change and booking lift.

name: Tenant Demand Letter Generator
problem: SA landlords get non-paying tenants; lawyers charge R1,500+ for a demand letter and the legal act is often cited wrong.
solution: Paste WhatsApp chat + lease details -> FIRE produces a compliant demand letter citing the correct section (e.g. Consumer Protection Act / Rental Housing Act) as a PDF.
distribution: Property WhatsApp groups, estate agents, rental agencies
mvp: Template engine with POPIA-safe data handling + legal review pass before release.
validation_experiment: Validate with 15 landlords via estate-agent referral; success = they actually send the letter.
kill_criteria: landlords prefer DIY templates to paying R150
scale_criteria: escalation bundle: letter + attorney referral fee

name: Spaza Shop Stock & Credit Ledger
problem: Spaza shops run on memory and notebooks; stock vanishes, credit customers are never chased, margins are guesswork.
solution: Simple WhatsApp/number-keypad ledger: log sales, track credit, get reorder alerts in plain language.
distribution: FMCG distributors who already visit shops weekly
mvp: SMS/USSD-style flow first (no smartphone app needed); distributor partner does onboarding.
validation_experiment: Distributor pilot: 20 shops; measure repeat usage after 30 days.

name: Invoice Chaser (3% of recovered)
problem: Freelancers and SMMEs lose cash flow because chasing invoices is awkward and inconsistent.
customer: SA freelancers & agencies with recurring receivables
solution: Connect Gmail -> FIRE monitors unpaid invoices and sends polite, escalating chase sequences; you take a % of recovered.
pricing: 3% of recovered amounts (no win, no fee)
distribution: Freelancer communities, accountants who refer clients
mvp: Gmail OAuth read + manual send first; only charge on verified recovery.
validation_experiment: 5 freelancers give 1 unpaid invoice each; recover 2 -> shows 3% works.
kill_criteria: freelancers unwilling to grant Gmail access

name: Tax Season Helper for Informal Traders
problem: SA informal traders fear SARS; bookkeepers charge too much; they file late and get penalties.
customer: Spaza owners, market traders, gig workers
solution: WhatsApp chat: snap receipts -> FIRE produces a SARS-ready provisional return summary in plain language.
distribution: Radio, community WhatsApp groups, SARS-accredited workshops
mvp: Receipt photo -> categorised income/expense summary -> printable form.
validation_experiment: Partner 1 community org; 30 filings; measure accuracy vs bookkeeper audit.
kill_criteria: users still need a professional to file

name: CV -> ATS Optimizer for Graduates
problem: SA graduates send CVs that ATS filters reject before a human sees them; they cannot afford professional CV writers.
customer: Unemployed/soon-to-graduate SA students applying through portals
solution: Upload CV + job spec -> FIRE rewrites the CV to pass ATS parsing and match keywords.
pricing: R99 per CV (one-off); R249 for CV + LinkedIn refresh
distribution: University WhatsApp groups, career centres, TikTok 'grad hacks' content
mvp: Form + Stripe/PayFast checkout; manual GPT-driven rewrite first, API later.
validation_experiment: Post on 5 university groups; offer first 20 CVs free; track repeat + referral rate.
kill_criteria: <10 paid conversions from first 100 free users
ATS pass rate not measurably higher
scale_criteria: referral loop: each paying grad refers 1+

name: Freelancer Proposal Generator (Gig Platforms)
problem: Freelancers lose gigs because proposals are generic; writing 5/day is exhausting.
customer: SA freelancers on Upwork/Fiverr/legit SA platforms
solution: Paste the job post -> FIRE drafts a tailored proposal + quote that references the client's exact wording.
mvp: Paste -> tailored proposal; A/B two templates to measure reply rate.
validation_experiment: 50 freelancers; measure reply-rate lift vs their baseline template.

name: School Admission Appeal Letters
problem: SA parents get rejection letters from oversubscribed schools; appeals are time-sensitive and must hit the right legal framing.
customer: SA parents (especially GDE placement season, Oct-Nov)
solution: Input school + reason + child profile -> FIRE drafts a persuasive appeal letter with correct department circular references.
distribution: Parent WhatsApp groups, education forums, seasonal SEO
mvp: Template + editing loop with a human review before send.
validation_experiment: Seasonal launch (GDE placement window); 20 letters; measure appeals accepted.
